def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Extract each connected 1-shape. A shape is activated only if its outline
    # encloses at least one blank cell (the demos' open outlines stay unchanged).
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=1 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==1 and p not in seen:
              seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
        y0=min(y for y,x in pts); y1=max(y for y,x in pts); x0=min(x for y,x in pts); x1=max(x for y,x in pts)
        # Determine if the component encloses any zero: flood blank cells from bbox border.
        box={(y,x) for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1)}
        zeros={p for p in box if grid[p[0]][p[1]]==0}
        exterior=set(); q=[]
        for y,x in zeros:
          if y in (y0,y1) or x in (x0,x1): exterior.add((y,x));q.append((y,x))
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop()
          for dy,dx in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if p in zeros and p not in exterior: exterior.add(p);q.append(p)
        interior=zeros-exterior
        if not interior: continue
        # Color enclosed interior 3, retaining zero holes within it as in examples.
        # The central blank is intentionally left untouched; fill other enclosed cells.
        for y,x in interior:
          if (y,x)!=((y0+y1)//2,(x0+x1)//2): out[y][x]=3
        # Add a one-cell 2 border around the object's overall bounding box.
        for y in range(y0-1,y1+2):
          for x in range(x0-1,x1+2):
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and (y in (y0-1,y1+1) or x in (x0-1,x1+1)) and grid[y][x]==0:
              out[y][x]=2
    return out
PY
